title: 점 세 개
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B with a mid-tempo groove. A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive four-bar loop featuring jazz-influenced seventh chords with a slight chorus effect. The drum kit consists of a dry, punchy kick on beats 1 and 3, a crisp snare on 2 and 4, and consistent eighth-note closed hi-hats. A melodic electric bass follows the kick drum pattern with occasional slides. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, rhythmic style, alternating between melodic rapping and soulful singing. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the vocal syncopation and the steady backbeat. Key of E Major, 92 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar loop, punchy kick drum, crisp snare]

[Verse 1]
[smooth male vocals]

같은 자리 같은 아메리카노
핸드폰 내려놓고 창밖 보는 게

규칙이라면 규칙이었다
바리스타가 내 얼굴을 기억한다
주문도 안 했는데 아메리카노가 나온다
단골이라는 건 좋은 건데

무언가를 읽고 있다
